baseline_models.focus_anchor: سخرها, the seven-night/eight-day count, and حسوما.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purpose-bound subjection and an exact night/day count make the wind a scheduled operation. The two faces of time and the unbroken-succession branch of حسوما close off pauses: the force remains on task across the whole interval.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound subjection makes the wind an instrument assigned to a specific end.
The numerical branch fixes one edge of the operation at seven nights.
Night and its darkness supply the operation's nocturnal face rather than an incidental time label.
Eight supplies the offset daytime count that completes the stated temporal envelope.
The span-of-time branch lets the days function as measured duration, not only daylight units.
Unbroken succession removes any recovery interval and turns the count into continuous exposure.

changed_reading.before: A destructive wind happened to last seven nights and eight days.
changed_reading.after: The wind is a commissioned process whose exact duration and uninterrupted execution belong to its destructive mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: القوم صرعى كأنهم أعجاز نخل خاوية.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse reverses a standing human collective into cast-down vegetal structure. قوم activates bodily uprightness, صرعى supplies the throw to earth, أعجاز relocates identity to rear or residual bases, and خاوية completes both collapse and loss of support.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily standing supplies the initial posture that the scene violently reverses.
Casting down to the ground performs the central vertical reversal.
The rear or hind-part branch reduces once-whole figures to residual bases or trunk ends.
The date-palm branch supplies the tall organic support whose felling models the bodies.
Falling and structural collapse complete the conversion from standing people to failed trunks.

changed_reading.before: The dead merely resemble fallen palm trunks in shape.
changed_reading.after: The simile stages a structural reversal: an upright collective is thrown down and reduced to failed bases, so posture and social solidity are destroyed together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فترى and the detailed corpse-to-palm comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second-person act of seeing turns the aftermath into an exhibited result. The chain from people to fallen material to vacant palms is arranged for inspection, making the simile evidentiary rather than merely ornamental.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing positions the addressee as an inspector of a visible result.
Making something seen gives the scene the function of disclosure, not passive scenery.
The human collective is the identifiable subject whose condition is publicly displayed.
The fallen or dried branch image bridges bodies and inspectable storm debris.
Vacancy makes the displayed remains testify to the absence of their former occupants or life.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports what the victims looked like after the storm.
changed_reading.after: The verse deliberately exhibits a legible afterimage: the visible bodies are evidence from which the addressee is made to infer emptied life and destroyed collective form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verse identifies the subjected agent as a cold wind whose branch field includes force and dominance, while عتو supplies refusal of ordinary obedience. Read back into سخرها, the paradox is hierarchical: a force that exceeds creaturely limits is itself exactly governed and aimed.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound command provides the higher control under which the excessive force operates.
Unbroken succession shows that control maintains rather than dampens the wind's operation.
Falling into annihilation supplies the explicitly stated endpoint of the wind's task.
Wind as force and dominance supplies the agent's overpowering capacity.
The cold-wind branch gives the commanded force a physically punishing medium.
Refusal of obedience supplies the force's apparent limitlessness, which higher subjection contains.

structural_cues: 69:6 immediately supplies the antecedent of سخرها and stacks destruction, wind, coldness, and عاتية before the focus gives duration and result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cold, overpowering, disobedience-coded wind and its annihilating result; I infer that سخر reverses its apparent autonomy into exact higher service. A live alternative is that عاتية only intensifies the storm and contributes no hierarchy beyond the explicit subjection.

changed_reading.before: Subjection means that an otherwise ordinary wind is used as a tool.
changed_reading.after: Subjection governs a force defined by excess: its wildness toward the victims and its obedience to the assigning power coexist rather than cancel each other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats seeing but converts it into a question about any remainder. That revision distinguishes visible residue from living or enduring continuity: the bodies can fill the field of vision while counting as no بَاقِيَة at all.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing supplies the initial inspection of the bodies.
Vacancy makes the visible forms present while their sustaining life is absent.
Repeated seeing turns the prior tableau into the evidence searched for by the question.
The branch of what remains sets the criterion the visible corpses fail: they preserve no viable remainder.

structural_cues: 69:8 follows without a scene change and repeats ترى inside a yes-or-no search for any باقية.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible fallen forms followed by a visual test for remainder; I infer that corpse-residue is being contrasted with continuance. A live alternative is that 69:8 simply restates total death without distinguishing kinds of remainder.

changed_reading.before: The corpses are the remains left by the storm.
changed_reading.after: The corpses are paradoxical anti-remains: visually present debris that proves no human continuity remained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later flood sequence contrasts being carried in a vessel with making an event a reminder held by a receptive ear. Read back into فترى, the ruined bodies become a negative vessel: their palm-like forms hold and transmit the memory of what cannot carry life forward.

activation_trace.role: Making seen lets the ruined scene function as a deliberately presented mnemonic object.
The durable palm form gives the memory a concrete visual carrier.
Collapse marks this carrier as wreckage rather than a vessel of survival.
Bearing a visible load supplies the contrasting mechanism of preservation through catastrophe.
A reminder explicitly assigns past catastrophe a future memory function.
Containing something in a vessel supplies the storage model for receiving the exhibited scene.
Attentive acceptance identifies the human receiver that turns catastrophe into retained warning.

structural_cues: 69:11-12 moves from a vessel that carries survivors to an event made into a reminder and contained by a receptive ear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical carrying, mnemonic making, and receptive containment; I infer that the focus tableau is a negative memorial whose empty forms carry warning instead of life. A live alternative is that only the flood episode, not the wind scene, receives the explicit memorial function.

changed_reading.before: The palm-trunk image records destruction vividly.
changed_reading.after: The image also operates as a negative ark: emptied forms carry the event into memory even though they carried no people through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence collapses mountains, makes the event fall, weakens the sky, and then exposes everyone. It scales up the focus's bodily geometry: upright supports fail, elevated mass is leveled, and the resulting condition is presented for inspection.

activation_trace.role: Human uprightness supplies the small-scale support whose failure begins the analogy.
Casting down gives the focus scene the same downward vector as the later cosmic event.
Collapse turns the bodies and palms into a local model of failed structure.
Elevated solid mass supplies the larger support structure subjected to failure.
Pounding and leveling generalize the focus's felling from bodies and trees to terrain.
Falling and becoming fixed turns downward motion into an accomplished event-state.
Weakening supplies the failure of the highest enclosing structure after lower supports fall.
Exhibiting something for view extends the focus's visual inspection to universal presentation.

structural_cues: 69:13-18 progresses from one blast through leveled earth and mountains, a weakened sky, and universal exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated support failure, downward leveling, and later exhibition; I infer a scale relation in which the felled people are a material rehearsal of cosmic collapse. A live alternative is that the scenes share catastrophe vocabulary without the focus serving as a model of the later one.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a historically bounded scene of bodies felled by wind.
changed_reading.after: The bodies form a small-scale diagram of a wider collapse grammar: standing supports fail, worlds are leveled, and the result is exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's seven/eight duration joins later exact allocations: eight bearers and a chain measured at seventy cubits. This recurrence lets number function as calibration of force, burden, and duration rather than decorative precision.

activation_trace.role: Seven begins the exact calibration of the wind's temporal load.
Eight completes the focus count and creates a number later reused for assigned bearing.
A measured span of time supplies the first dimension being calibrated.
Unbroken succession makes the measured interval operational rather than merely chronological.
The repeated eight assigns an exact number to a later load-bearing arrangement.
Connected chain links provide the later instrument whose extent is explicitly measured.
Measurement by cubit makes calibrated extent explicit rather than inferred.
The numerical branch expands seven into seventy within another precisely dimensioned punishment.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats eight at 69:17 and expands seven to seventy inside the measured chain at 69:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurring numbers attached to duration, bearing, and chain length; I infer a shared logic of assigned measure and capacity. A live alternative is ordinary numerical coincidence with no mechanism linking the three scenes.

changed_reading.before: Seven nights and eight days provide historical duration.
changed_reading.after: The count can also mark calibrated administration: the destructive force is allotted a duration as exactly as later forces and burdens are allotted bearers and length.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of severing the life artery sharpens the cutting branch of حسوما. With the victims already rendered as palm rears and collapsed trunks, annihilation becomes loss of the connection by which organism and collective continue, not only accumulated impact.

activation_trace.role: Decisive cutting supplies a severance mechanism already latent in the focus description.
Extirpation turns severance into removal of the group's capacity to continue.
Residual hind parts or bases give the severing mechanism a visible remainder.
Palm trunks materialize the organic body whose continuity has been cut.
Collapse displays the structural consequence of losing the vital connection.
Severing and separation supplies the directional action that sharpens حسوما.
The life-artery image identifies what kind of connection makes cutting terminal.

structural_cues: 69:46 gives an explicit cut-plus-life-line construction; 69:7 gives cut-off duration and bodies resembling residual trunks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive cutting in the focus and later severing of a life artery; I infer that the palm-body field visualizes severed continuity at both bodily and communal scales. A live alternative is that the two cuts only share a terminal endpoint and should not be treated as one material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: حسوما says that the prolonged wind annihilated the people.
changed_reading.after: The wind's annihilation is legible as vital severance: it cuts the sustaining continuity and leaves only collapsed organic bases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches of interposing barrier and protective ward activate the focus's geometry. سخرها عليهم places the force against or over them, while حسوما keeps it continuous; no gap, shield, or mediator interrupts the assigned contact.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound directing supplies the vector that places the force onto its target.
Unbroken succession means no temporal barrier interrupts exposure.
Interposition by a separator supplies the absent spatial mechanism that could have broken contact.
Warding off harm by protection supplies the absent defensive mechanism.

structural_cues: The focus preposition عليهم gives directed contact; later 69:47-48 places barrier and protection language side by side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed subjection, continuity, interposition, and warding; I infer that the victims' exposure is total because neither spatial separation nor protection breaks the wind's contact. A live alternative is that the later barrier and protection language belongs only to the revelation passage and does not reactivate the storm's geometry.

changed_reading.before: The wind blows upon the people continuously.
changed_reading.after: عليهم becomes a geometry of unshielded contact: the assigned force reaches them without temporal pause, spatial separator, or effective protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of what is seen and unseen, followed by reality and certainty, enlarges فترى from optical report into evidentiary training. The visible ruined bodies become the inspectable half of a claim whose reach exceeds sight.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye supplies the concrete evidence from which the larger judgment begins.
Reflective judgment lets vision become inference rather than remain a retinal report.
Eye-sight explicitly marks the visible domain to which the focus aftermath belongs.
Heart-insight supplies a mode for carrying the visible evidence toward what vision alone does not contain.
Reality matching fact gives the inspected aftermath an epistemic endpoint opposed to denial.
Settled knowledge without doubt names the certainty toward which the exhibited scene presses.

structural_cues: 69:38-39 deliberately pairs the visible and invisible, and 69:51 closes with حق اليقين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus imperative-like address to see, a later visible/invisible pair, and certainty language; I infer that the corpse tableau trains inference from manifest effect to a reality beyond immediate sight. A live alternative is that فترى remains only vivid narration while the epistemic frame begins much later.

changed_reading.before: You are asked to picture a visible historical aftermath.
changed_reading.after: You are made to inspect a visible effect as evidence: sight is the first step in a judgment that the later visible/unseen and certainty frame completes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping under focus ترى rather than its ordinary seeing root. It remains valid as a mapped split-root resonance and is sharpened by the immediate question about any remainder; downstream prose must call it a form-distant activation, never a lexical gloss of ترى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus ترى, the vacant remains, and the immediate visual search for a باقية.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's residue branch lets the act of seeing carry an oblique remainder-image.
Vacancy distinguishes the remaining visible form from continued life.
What remains supplies the explicit next-verse test that reverses the residue-image.

changed_reading.before: ترى simply introduces the sight of bodies left after the wind.
changed_reading.after: At the level of split-root resonance, seeing delivers apparent residue only for the next verse to deny that this residue is any enduring remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نخل is plainly the palm in the simile, while the sifting branch is form-distant. It remains anchored in that exact focus root and coheres with a whole people cast down and no remainder; downstream prose should present a secondary sieve-image activated by the noun, not replace the palm translation with sifting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's نخل root inside a commanded process that casts down the whole قوم.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound operation supplies the agency for a secondary filtering mechanism.
The group of people supplies the collective material subjected to that filtering.
Casting down supplies the separated material deposited after the process.
Sifting flour through a sieve activates an exploratory process-image beneath the explicit palm image.
The absence of any remainder supplies the terminal condition of the imagined sifting.

changed_reading.before: The wind leaves people lying like palm trunks.
changed_reading.after: A secondary branch-image makes the prolonged wind act like a sieve upon the collective, depositing felled forms while allowing no viable human remainder through.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the material vacancy of خاوية to form-distant uncovering branches under حسرة and covering branches under كفر. It remains anchored in the hollow human-palm forms and packet-local concealment vocabulary; downstream prose must qualify it as a moral-material reversal, not derive the ordinary meanings of حسرة or كفر from those remote images.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's visibly vacant human-palm shells.

activation_trace.role: Vacancy turns the bodies into present exteriors emptied of what they once enclosed.
Hollowness of the belly materializes inward depletion within the palm-body image.
Removal of a covering activates exposure as the reversal imposed on the emptied forms.
Being bare of protection joins physical exposure to the failure of shelter.
Covering supplies the action materially reversed by visible emptiness and exposure.
Concealing truth supplies the moral domain that the exposed corpse-field reverses.

changed_reading.before: The hollow trunks convey physical death and collapse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained cross-domain activation, the hollow trunks become exposed coverings: concealment ends in an exterior made visible precisely because its sustaining interior and protection are gone.

strongest_changes: The counted storm changed from a long event into a purpose-bound, uninterrupted operation.
The palm simile changed from visual resemblance into a reversal of upright bodily and collective support.
The repeated seeing and remainder question changed visible corpses into anti-remains that prove extinction rather than continuity.
Later cut-life-line and barrier vocabulary sharpened the mechanism as vital severance under unshielded contact.
Cosmic collapse and exact later measures kept material-scale and calibrated-administration readings alive beside the historical scene.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports simultaneous temporal and cutting senses of حسوما, while قوم/صرعى/أعجاز/نخل/خاوية creates a dense standing-to-collapse mechanism. Context then changes the same tableau into a remnant test, negative memorial, scale model, and evidentiary display; split-root and remote branch images add residue, sieve, and exposed-covering outliers without displacing the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The succession, decisive-cutting, and extirpation branches of حسوما may be deliberately cumulative or only neighboring lexical affordances.
The recurrence of seven, eight, and measured seventy may encode calibrated assignment or may be ordinary scene-specific counting.
The split-root residue, palm-sieve, and exposed-covering readings are packet-licensed activations but must not be promoted into lexical translations.
خاوية can keep vacancy, bodily hollowness, and structural collapse live together; the focus alone does not force one image to exclude the others.
